name: m2t4
description: Age-advancement ladder fixture on the pinned seed-20260823 map: a Dark-Age town center, stable and house stand pre-stamped while six villagers idling nearby drive the whole Dark→Feudal→Castle→Imperial run through researchAge commands at the TC. The fixture opens with both polite gate refusals — a blacksmith placement and a stable scout-cavalry order while still Dark Age — recorded as digest-visible GateRejected rows that pay nothing and spawn nothing. Feudal lands at tick 3902, unlocking the first blacksmith pair (placed and built by villagers one and two/three-and-four respectively), a scout-cavalry trains out of the stable, Castle follows at 9599 once the two prior-age military buildings stand, and Imperial completes at 14799. Every advance escrows its tech cost at enqueue and counts its command tick as the first research tick (completion = enqueue + researchTime − 1). Milestone digests every 30th tick plus final; doubles as the determinism canary.
